lines.en: I want to auction off a personalized Johnny Karate song tomorrow,
so I need you to come to the auction.
Auction? Okay, yeah, let me write that down.
Andy, you already have three Johnny Karate shows tomorrow.
No, not according to my file here.
Okay, we need a better system.
Look, I'll just write down an itinerary for you,
so you can just focus on songs.
Okay, well, you have to catalog all this stuff.
I mean, this is ours worth of work.
What is that? Don't tell secrets.
Andy, if you have a secret, you have to tell me.
That's the whole point of marriage.
I don't have anything. I'm not acting weird.
Excuse me, I have to get back to work now.
we have a half hour to get to the next party.
That gives us 15 minutes of travel time
and 15 minutes for you to take a wet nap shower in the car.
I don't want to break my promise.
He has some kind of disease.
So that's why you've been so nice to him
and let him carry all your stuff.
So, um, Andy told me what's going on.
Oh, I was trying to keep it hush-hush.
You know, it's kind of embarrassing.
Well, if you ever need to talk to anyone, I'm here for you.
Like, you know, I'm here, standing near you.
Well, earlier today I was licking icing off of my finger
and then, boom, I swallowed my wedding ring.
And I wish I could say it was the first time, but--
I mean, can it be painful?
But the good news is I've gotten very good at passing it.
It's a matter of getting out the old calendar.
So, I've been talking to Larry, and he's definitely not dying.
Technically, we're all dying, unless you choose the right grail.
Andy, I was nice to Larry.
I had a conversation with him.
How can you do that to me?
He has the same disease Larry has.
They're moving again to Chinatown in France.
Do you really want to know?
Tom has something wrong with his butt.
Honey, the kids want an encore.
Babe, you don't have to hide from me.
I don't care about the secret anymore, okay?
I just thought when we got married we would share everything, but if you really can't tell me or whatever, it's fine.
It's just that it's a really big secret.
And for once I wanted to keep my word.
Everybody, if you could gather around.
Don't try to get it out of me.
The reason I have been acting so weird is not because I've been waiting for the results of the soil samples to come back.
Well, geez, I've been up all night trying to make sure you didn't--
It was a pointless ruse designed to waste time.
I'm sure you will both raise a wonderful child with whom I will profoundly disagree on nearly everything.
Well, actually, and this is crazy, but it's children.
And I'm all freaked out about it.
Babe, I'm so glad you didn't tell me.
